scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @agencyos/api" "npm run dev -w @agencyos/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @agencyos/api && npm run build -w @agencyos/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @agencyos/api && npm run lint -w @agencyos/web
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e:ci
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run build && npm run test && npm run test:integration
